name: Traumatic Shock
description: Usually occurring during unsafe surgery conditions, causing potentially lethal Hypotension. To perform safe surgery a patient must be under the effects of Analgesia and near any Bed, or be Unconscious.

code.title: Traumatic Shock
code.effects: Hypotension, Cardiac Arrest, Respiratory Arrest, Neurotrauma, Psychosis, Pain.

name: Traumatic Amputation
description: Most of the tissue of the right leg was torn off. This limb can be replaced after Sawing Bones.

code.title: Traumatic Right Leg Amputation
notes: Applied via Damage Sustained. Does nothing.

name: Traumatic Shock Immunity
description: The patient was left unattended, for some time they won't be aware about having themselves opened.

code.title: TShockTimeout
notes: Applied during level change to prevent Traumatic Shock from taking place.

name: Unconsciousness
description: The patient is unconscious. Usually caused by severe physical trauma, Hypoxemia, Neurotrauma, an Aortic Rupture or an Opiate Overdose.

code.title: Unconsciousness
notes: Removes itself when conditions are NOT met. Applied by other afflictions.

name: Vomiting
description: The patient is vomiting periodically. Usually caused by Kidney Damage, Alcohol consumption or Hemotransfusion Shock. Vomiting will cause Alkalosis.

code.title: Vomiting
notes: Removes itself when conditions are NOT met. Applied by other afflictions.

name: Vomiting Blood
description: The patient is vomiting blood periodically. Usually caused by severe Internal Bleeding or Liver Damage.

code.title: Vomiting Blood
notes: Removes itself when conditions are NOT met. Applied by other afflictions.

name: Weakness
description: The patient is experiencing weakness in the extremities. Usually caused by Cardiac Tamponade, Blood Loss or Acidosis.

code.title: Weakness
notes: Removes itself when conditions are NOT met. Applied by other afflictions.

name: Wheezing
description: The patients breathing is producing a high-pitched noise. Usually caused by Hemotransfusion Shock.

code.title: Wheezing
notes: Removes itself when conditions are NOT met. Applied by other afflictions.
